blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich
platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge
devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits an edge
platform’s memory, latency, and energy budgets while preserving navigation
behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized
VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model
with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal
transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action
verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which
reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We
characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 8 to 2 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible
operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by
quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional
backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate
stop heads on BF16 and IQ4_NL across all 1,839 1{,}839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen
episodes, where agents follow language instructions through photorealistic
indoor scans. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy,
and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our
highest SR, 58.02 % 58.02\% on the deployed four-bit model, exceeding the BF16
baseline with only 0.013 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step.
Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 × 36.8\times by execution path. Only IQ4_NL under our VLN driver fits the
board: 11.35 11.35 GB resident, 20.8 × 20.8\times faster, and 13.3 × 13.3\times less energy
than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token
pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Language conditioned mobile robots increasingly rely on vision-language navigation (VLN) models to translate visual observations and natural-language instructions into navigation actions. However, many openly available VLN models are designed without the resource constraints of the platforms on which they are deployed. Current systems commonly combine a SigLIP class vision encoder with a dense language decoder of several billion parameters; the model we study needs 16.1 16.1 GB for weights alone in BF16 [ 1 ] . This exceeds the practical memory budget of representative edge platforms such as the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB, whose shared LPDDR5 memory must support the GPU, CPU, operating system, camera pipeline, key–value cache, and compute buffers. As a result, navigation inference is often moved to a remote server, with the robot continuously streaming RGB-D observations over a network connection. This architecture introduces communication dependent latency, requires persistent connectivity, and transfers the robot’s visual observations off the platform.
blocks.zh: 语言有条件的移动机器人越来越依赖视觉语言导航(VLN)模型将视觉观测和自然语言指令转化为导航行动. 然而,许多公开提供的VLN模型的设计没有受到部署这些模型的平台的资源限制。 目前的系统通常将SigLIP类视觉编码器与数十亿参数的密集语言解码器结合;我们研究的模型单在BF16 [1]中需要16.1 16.1 GB的重量. 这超过了代表性边缘平台如NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB的实际内存预算,其共享的LPDDR5内存必须支持GPU,CPU,操作系统,相机管道,密钥-值缓存,以及计算缓冲. 因此,导航推论经常被移动到远程服务器,机器人通过网络连接不断流传RGB-D观测. 这个架构引入了通讯依赖性,需要持续的连通性,并将机器人的视觉观察从平台上转移.

blocks.en: Weight quantization is a natural way to reduce the memory footprint of VLN models, but embodied deployment is not determined by bit width alone. On this board, PyTorch doesn’t provide a 4-bit tensor-core path, so the benefit of 4-bit weights is primarily lower storage and memory traffic, while the framework itself consumes roughly 3 3 GB of the 16 16 GB budget. Nominal weight size also fails to predict peak residency, because runtime overhead, KV-cache allocation, and compute buffers decide whether a model fits. Compression is further limited because only selected layers are quantized, while the attention projections, embeddings, LM head, vision tower, and projector remain at higher precision. Finally, quantization must be judged in closed-loop navigation, where a single incorrect action changes future observations and can compound over the trajectory.
blocks.zh: 重量量化是减少VLN模型记忆足迹的自然方法,但体现的部署并非仅由位宽决定. 在这个板子上,PyTorch并不提供4位的百分数核心路径,因此4位重的优点主要是存储和内存流量较低,而框架本身消耗了16 16 GB预算的大约3 3 GB. 名义重量大小也未能预测峰值居住,因为运行时间超高,KV-cache分配,以及计算缓冲器决定一个模型是否适合. 压缩进一步受到限制,因为只有选定的层被量化,而注意力投影,嵌入,LM头,视觉塔,和投影仪仍然保持更高的精度. 最后,量化必须在闭路导航中进行判断,在闭路导航中,一个单一的不正确动作会改变未来的观测结果,并且可以在轨迹上复合.

blocks.en: We characterize StreamVLN [ 1 ] under INT8, INT4, NF4, IQ4_NL, and INT2 weight quantization evaluating on step-by-step navigation on R2R VLN-CE Dataset val-unseen split [ 2 ] on habitat simulator, measuring success, latency, energy, and resident memory on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB. Treating the inference runtime as a design variable alongside bit width, a hardware–software co-design view of edge deployment, we identify IQ4_NL with llama.cpp [ 3 ] as a practical operating point that preserves near-BF16 navigation performance while sharply reducing on-board latency and energy. The same characterization also isolates the remaining accuracy headroom. Across viable precisions, the gap between success rate (SR) and oracle success rate (OSR) remains nearly unchanged, from 7.35 7.35 points at BF16 to 6.80 6.80 points at deployed IQ4_NL, indicating that incorrect termination is a property of the base model rather than a quantization artifact; only at 2 bits, where the model collapses, does the gap increase. Motivated by this, we introduce LATTE (Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor), a lightweight real-time Stop Action verifier for continuous VLN-CE that rescores termination decisions from activations already produced by the backbone, operating within the runtime and memory budget reclaimed by quantization.
blocks.zh: 我们在INT8、INT4、NF4、IQ4_NL和INT2的量子化下对R2R VLN-CE Dataset val-unseen discription [2]在生境模拟器、测量成功度、耐久度、能量以及Jetson Orin NX 16GB上的常住记忆进行分步导航评估。 将推论运行时间与比特宽度,硬件-软件共设计边缘部署视图一起作为设计变量处理,我们将IQ4_NL与lama.cpp [3] 识别为一个实用的操作点,既能保持近BF16导航性能,又能大幅降低机上空闲和能量. 同样的定性也隔离了剩余的准确度头室. 在所有可行的精度上,成功率(SR)和甲骨文成功率(OSR)之间的差距几乎保持不变,从BF16的7.357.35分到部署的IQ4_NL的6.806.80分,表明不正确的终止是基模型的属性而不是量化的文物;只有在模型崩溃的2位时,差距才会增加. 以此为动机,我们引入了LATTE(Latent Trepjectory Extermination Extrator),这是用于连续VLN-CE的轻量级实时停止动作验证器,它从主干线已经产生的激活中重新记录终止决定,运行在运行时间和通过量化回收的内存预算.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this study are as follows: • We propose an end-to-end deployment pipeline that runs an 8.03 \mathbf{8.03} B VLN model [ 1 ] on an Orin NX 16GB and evaluates five weight quantization formats across two inference runtimes under full closed-loop rollout on all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE Dataset val-unseen split episodes, where an agent follows language instructions through photorealistic indoor environments to reach a target location, with latency, energy, and resident memory measured on-board. • We introduce Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor(LATTE), an inline real-time Stop Action verifier that operates without an additional backbone forward pass. On our deployed EdgeVLN system, LATTE improves SR to 58.02 % \mathbf{58.02\%} ( Δ ​ SR = + 0.71 \Delta\mathrm{SR}=\mathbf{+0.71} points) for 0.013 \mathbf{0.013} s more per navigation step. • Our EdgeVLN model provides a deployable quantization–runtime operating point, IQ4_NL under our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs the streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board, that reduces resident memory by 1.32 × \mathbf{1.32\times} , latency by 20.8 × \mathbf{20.8\times} , and energy per navigation step by 13.3 × \mathbf{13.3\times} relative to BF16.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: This section reviews three lines of work: efficient VLA/VLN deployment, vision–language model quantization, and oracle-gap reduction in navigation. These address complementary aspects of embodied inference, but not the joint problem of deploying large VLN models on resource-constrained robots.
blocks.zh: 本节审查三条工作线:高效的VLA/VLN部署,视觉-语言模式量化,以及导航中的甲骨文-gap减少。 这些讨论涉及的是内在推论的互补方面,但不涉及在受资源限制的机器人上部署大型VLN模型的共同问题。

blocks.en: II-A Efficient VLA and VLN at the Edge
blocks.zh: II-A 边疆的VLA和VLN

blocks.en:
VLN Models [ 1 , 4 ] couple a video–language backbone with a bounded temporal context to produce
low latency navigation decisions, but their language models are sized for server class GPUs rather than embedded platforms.
Efficient vision–language–action (VLA) work has focused on manipulation: [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] apply quantization, architectural simplification, or early exit to tabletop and arm control, and Vishwanathan et al. attribute roughly 75 % 75\% of step latency on Jetson to memory bound autoregressive generation [ 8 ] .
EdgeNav-QE [ 9 ] combines QLoRA
quantization with dynamic early exit inference for large navigation models and
evaluates navigation in Habitat-Sim. However, these studies report latency
under a single precision and runtime, and none characterize energy per
decision across multiple weight formats and inference runtimes on a
memory-constrained platform.

blocks.en:
Post-training methods such as
Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) [ 10 ] and low-bit inference
formats such as GGUF/Q4_K_M primarily target the language backbone while
typically retaining higher precision in the vision encoder. Recent
hardware aware studies also show that quantization does not translate
directly from nominal model compression to inference efficiency, as
dequantization and hardware–software interactions can affect runtime
performance [ 11 ] .
This motivates selecting quantization and runtime jointly.

blocks.en: II-C Oracle Gap and Stop Action Verification Methods
blocks.zh: II-C 甲骨文差距和停止行动核查方法

blocks.en:
Mind the Gap [ 12 ] demonstrates that an auxiliary verification
module can reduce the gap between Success Rate (SR) and Oracle Success Rate
(OSR) in discrete panoramic navigation by reevaluating previously visited
viewpoints and selecting a better candidate.
Edge VLM studies characterizing quantization use static image–text evaluation [ 11 ] rather than closed-loop rollout.
Moreover, the viewpoint selection mechanism of Mind the Gap does not directly transfer to continuous
VLN-CE, where revisiting an earlier viewpoint requires physical navigation.
We therefore adapt the verification idea to continuous VLN-CE by predicting
the Stop Action from the backbone’s temporal decision-step embeddings, without
revisiting or reselecting previous viewpoints, and design it for inline
operation on an edge deployed VLN system.

blocks.en: III-A Base Agent: StreamVLN
blocks.zh: 三A基地 代理商: StreamVLN

blocks.en:
Our system builds upon StreamVLN [ 1 ] , a streaming VLN framework
with a LLaVA-style architecture: a SigLIP-SO400M-patch14-384 vision tower, a
two-layer MLP projector, and a Qwen2 language model ( 28 28 layers, d = 3584 d=3584 ), 8.03 8.03 B parameters in total. StreamVLN combines a fast-streaming dialogue
context, held in a sliding-window KV cache, with a slow-updating memory
context, so inference never reprocesses the full navigation history. When the
window reaches its boundary the dialogue context is recomputed and repopulated
with stride-sampled memory tokens.
Memory growth is bounded by a voxel-based
spatial token pruning rule, which we implement inside our VLN driver so that it runs on-board
(§ III-B ). It is inactive in the RGB-only VLN-CE setting, whose
evaluation agent supplies the encoder with a placeholder pose and a
zero-valued depth map.

blocks.en: III-B Quantization and Runtime Deployment Path
blocks.zh: 三-B 量化和运行时间部署路径

blocks.en: The board’s 16 GB must hold the operating system, runtime, KV cache, and compute buffers as well as the model, so full-precision weights cannot remain resident. We therefore quantize only the language-model feed-forward blocks, 5.70 5.70 B of 8.03 8.03 B parameters, leaving the vision tower, projector, attention projections, embeddings, and LM head at 16 16 bits. We first sweep candidate precisions with fake quantization, which rounds weights to the target grid but stores them in 16 16 -bit form. This isolates precision from runtime: it measures each format’s success rate in a controlled stack, so any later on-board gap is attributable to the deployment path rather than the format itself. The memory saving appears only in a runtime with native low-bit kernels. We therefore deploy with llama.cpp , which encodes one image per turn but provides no interface for the model’s rolling context. Our driver reconstructs that context by exporting the vision tower and projector to the runtime’s multimodal format, re-implementing the × → × 14 27\!\times\!27\!\rightarrow\!14\!\times\!14 pooling that yields 196 196 tokens per frame, and clearing the context every 32 32 steps while re-injecting stride-sampled earlier frames as raw embedding batches. The deployed stack thus consists of GGUF weights, our driver, and the runtime, with no deep-learning framework in the inference path.
blocks.zh: 董事会的16GB必须持有操作系统,运行时间,KV缓存,计算缓冲以及模型,因此全精度权重不能保持常住状态. 因此,我们只将语言模型的饲料前进区块,8.03 8.03 B参数的5.70 5.70 B, 将视塔,投影仪,注意力预测,嵌入, LM 头等16比特进行量化. 我们首先用假的量子化来扫描候选精度,这些精度将重量反射到目标网格,但存储在16位16位. 它将精度与运行时间隔开:它用一个可控的堆栈测量每种格式的成功率,所以任何后来的机载漏洞都归因于部署路径而不是格式本身. 内存保存只在有原生低位内核的运行时间出现. 因此,我们用 lama.cpp 进行部署,它每转弯编码一个图像,但没有为模型的滚动上下文提供接口。 我们的驱动程序通过导出视觉塔和投影器到运行时的多模式格式来重建这种上下文,重新执行 ~ ~ 14 27\ ~ 14 27\ ! 27\ 右转 14\ 14\ ! 集合后每帧产生196,196个令牌,每32个步骤清除上下文,同时将脚踏实地的早期帧重新注入为原始嵌入批次. 因此,部署的堆栈由GGUF权重、我们的驱动器和运行时间组成,在推论路径中没有深入学习的框架。

blocks.en: Voxel-based spatial pruning is described in the original StreamVLN work [ 1 ] but is not released in its implementation, so we implement it directly in our llama.cpp -based driver. Each token cell takes the median of its valid depth pixels, is back-projected to a voxel index using the platform’s depth and pose streams, and only the most recent token per voxel is retained within each temporal bucket. The pruning is applied only when visual history is re-injected, adding no latency on ordinary steps and incurring its cost at chunk boundaries, where the re-injected history is largest.
blocks.zh: Voxel基空间推算在最初的StreamVLN工作[1]中描述,但在执行中并未发布,因此我们直接在我们的lama.cpp基驱动器中执行. 每个令牌单元格取其有效深度像素的中位数,利用平台的深度反向投射到voxel指数,并摆出流,每个时空桶中只保留每个voxel的最新令牌. 只有在视觉历史被重新注入时才应用普鲁恩语,在普通步骤上不增加暂时性,并在块边界上承担其成本,在那里重新注入的历史最大.

blocks.en: III-C LATTE: Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor
blocks.zh: 三-C LATTE: 底线线性终止提取器

blocks.en: Fig. 2: EdgeVLN inference path. Input : a language instruction and the current camera frame. The quantized StreamVLN model encodes them into a chunk of four actions, and LATTE reads the same forward pass’s layer-24 activations to predict the Stop Action verifier rank. Output : the Stop Action verifier rank triggers STOP or the next action, which the robot executes to produce the next frame.
blocks.zh: 图2:EdgeVLN推断路径. 输入:一种语言指示和当前相机帧. LATTE读了同一前传的层-24激活, 以预测停止行动验证器的级别。 输出 : Stop Action 校验器会触发停止或下一个动作,由机器人执行生成下一个帧.

blocks.en:
The LATTE block reads the backbone’s own layer-24 hidden state then mean-pools the 196 image-token rows of each frame to obtain a 3584-dimensional feature. These activations are already produced by the navigation forward pass, so the verifier adds neither a second vision encoder nor any extra backbone compute; only the head itself is new.
Decision features are accumulated in a buffer of up to T = 256 T=256 decision steps and temporally averaged over T = 16 T=16 steps before projection to d = 256 d=256 .
blocks.zh:
LATTE块读取主干线本身的层-24隐藏状态,然后将每个帧的196个图像键行平均集合,以获得3584维特性. 这些激活器已经由导航前传产生,因此核查器既未添加第二个视觉编码器,也未添加任何额外的骨干计算;只有头本身是新的.
决策特征累积在最多为T=256 T=256决定步骤的缓冲中,在预测到d=256 d=256之前,在T=16 T=16步骤上的时间平均值.

blocks.en: Because the supervision target is not a per-frame quantity, whether the agent has already passed its closest approach is a property of the trajectory, so the head is sequential rather than pointwise. Each buffered decision embedding is projected to d = 256 d=256 , combined with a learned positional embedding, and processed by two pre-norm transformer encoder layers with four heads and a feed-forward width of 512 512 . Attention is masked strictly causally with an unbounded history. A final LayerNorm and linear projection produce a scalar, followed by a sigmoid to obtain the Stop Action verifier rank r t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] r_{t}\in[0,1] for each decision step. The head regresses goal_rank_camera_height = clip ⁡ ( 1 − d t / d max , 0 , 1 ) =\mathrm{clip}\!\left(1-d_{t}/d_{\max},0,1\right) with d max = 5.0 d_{\max}=5.0 m, zeroed after the closest-approach step and whenever the goal fails the camera-height visibility test, under a mean-squared-error loss.
blocks.zh: 由于监督目标不是每帧数量,所以该剂是否已经通过最接近的方法是轨迹的属性,所以头部是连续的而不是指向的. 每个缓冲决定嵌入预计为d = 256 d = 256,结合一个已学习的定位嵌入,由两个预规范变压器编码层进行处理,4个头,向导宽度为512 512. 注意力完全被无约束的历史所掩盖。 最终的LyerNorm和线性投影产生一个scalar,然后是sigmoid,以获得每个决定步骤的停止动作验证器的r t {[0,1] r_{t}\in [0,1]. 头部递回进球_rank_camera_height = 剪切QQ(1–d t / d max, 0, 1 ) 左转(1-d_{t}/d_{\max }, 0, 1\right) , 以 d 最大 = 5.0 d_{\max = 5.0 m , 在最接近的进球后零, 每当球门未通过摄像头的能见度测试时, 均值-平方差- 。

blocks.en: The head is trained separately from the frozen model on 3184 collected successful rollouts features from R2R VLN-CE Dataset Train split, then split into 2548/318/318 train/val/test respectively at the episode level.
blocks.zh: 头部与3184年的冷冻型号分开训练,从R2R VLN-CE Dataset Train分拆中收集成功推出的特性,然后在插座一级分别分为2548/318/318次列车/val/测试.

blocks.en:
The predicted Stop Action verifier rank is consumed by a causal trigger with hysteresis. The
trigger tracks the running maximum of the score and issues STOP once
that maximum has exceeded a threshold and the current score has fallen a fixed
margin below it, so it reacts to a peak that has turned over rather than to
every local maximum. A minimum step count suppresses spurious early fires. Because incorrect stop decisions lower task success directly, the head is kept in FP32 and decoupled from the quantized backbone.
blocks.zh:
预言的停止动作验证器级别被带有歇斯底里语的因果触发器消耗. 那个
触发跟踪计分数的运行最大值并停止一次
最大值已超过一个阈值, 且当前得分已下降
下方的比值,所以它的反应是 峰值已经翻过而不是
每个当地最大。 起码的步数可以抑制虚假的早期火灾. 因为不正确的停止决定会直接降低任务的成功率,所以头部被保存在FP32中,并与被量化的骨干脱钩.

All variants use a frozen StreamVLN backbone quantized to IQ4_NL and different stop-prediction strategy: MLP-Vision(1,2), MLP-VT Concat, MLP-VT FiLM, LLM-hidden-MLP(L20,L24) and LATTE (ours), the selected candidate, taps intermediate Qwen2-7B hidden states and applies causal self-attention over recent hidden states for stop prediction. blocks.en:
Each configuration’s accuracy is scored in Habitat simulator on the R2R VLN-CE Dataset val-unseen split [ 2 ] , over all 1839 1839 episodes, in closed loop: every action is executed and the next observation is rendered from the resulting pose, so a single incorrect action changes the remainder of the trajectory. We report success rate (SR), the fraction of episodes in which the agent itself issues STOP within the success radius of the goal, and oracle success rate (OSR), the fraction whose executed trajectory passes within that radius at any point.
All configurations are scored on the same GPU, since identical models diverge
on different accelerators once a rollout is closed-loop. The Stop Action verification head’s trigger threshold and drop margin are selected per backbone by a 16 16 -cell grid search on the same val-unseen episodes we report, formed by the Cartesian product of threshold high ∈ { 0.4 , 0.5 , 0.6 , 0.7 } \text{threshold}_{\text{high}}\in\{0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7\} and drop margin ∈ { 0.1 , 0.15 , 0.2 , 0.25 } \text{drop}_{\text{margin}}\in\{0.1,0.15,0.2,0.25\} . Absent a held-out split, its gain should therefore be read as an upper bound.

每个配置的准确性在R2R VLN-CE Dataset val-unseen 分裂[2]上的生境模拟器中得分,在所有1839年的1839集中,以闭环循环进行:每个动作都执行,从产生的姿势中得出下一个观测结果,所以一个不正确的动作会改变轨迹的剩余部分. 我们报告成功率(SR),即代理人自己发布在目标成功半径范围内停止的几段事件,以及甲骨文成功率(OSR),即其执行的轨迹在任何时间都经过该半径范围内的一小部分.

blocks.en:
The memory savings are enough to recover the lost success rate, while Table I (b) shows that what the new Stop Action verification head reads determines whether recovery is possible.
Heads over pooled vision features lose accuracy outright, from 57.69 % 57.69\% to 51.70 % 51.70\% on BF16, and fusing the instruction does not rescue
them: concatenation is the worst head at 45.79 % 45.79\% , and FiLM ( 55.14 % 55.14\% ) merely
returns to the vision-only level. Only heads over the decoder’s own hidden
states gain, reaching 58.24 % 58.24\% at layer 20 and 58.13 % 58.13\% at layer 24. LATTE
reads the same layer-24 states through causal self-attention rather than a
pointwise MLP and improves on both at half the size, 58.35 % 58.35\% on BF16 and 58.02 % 58.02\% on IQ4_NL at 8.2 8.2 MB against 15.7 15.7 MB. The two backbones track
each other to within 0.33 0.33 points, comparable to the 0.38 points without the head, so
the gain carries over to the quantized model. On IQ4_NL it corrects 26 26 episodes and breaks 13 13 , and it acts where the design predicts: on
termination rather than on path-following, raising SR by 0.71 0.71 points while lowering OSR by 0.65 0.65 points.

彼此在0.330.33分之内,与没有头的0.38分相当,所以
收益会转移到量化模型上 在IQ4_NL上,它纠正了2626集,打破了13 13集,它在设计预测的地方起作用:
终止而不是路径跟踪,将SR提高0.71 0.71分,同时将OSR降低0.65 0.65分.

blocks.en: LATTE leaves deployed efficiency essentially unchanged. It adds 0.013 0.013 s and 0.13 0.13 J per navigation step ( 0.048 0.048 s and 0.48 0.48 J per decision, or + 1.9 % +1.9\% and + 1.1 % +1.1\% ) without an additional forward pass, since it consumes activations already produced by navigation. Average power falls slightly, from 16.97 16.97 to 16.84 16.84 W, because the head runs on the CPU and adds a phase in which the GPU is idle; as in BF16, energy is therefore the more meaningful metric.
blocks.zh: LATTE的部署效率基本不变。 它增加了0.013 0.013 s和0.13 0.13 J,每个导航步骤(0.048 0.048 s和0.48 048 J,或者+1.9% +1.9\%和+1.1% +1.1\%),没有额外的前行通道,因为它消耗了已经由导航产生的激活. 平均功率略有下降,从16.97 16.97降至16.84 16.84 W,因为头部运行在CPU上,并增加了GPU闲置的阶段;如BF16中,能量因此是更有意义的度量.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We introduce EdgeVLN, a deployment-ready quantized vision–language navigation model combining StreamVLN and LATTE, an inline Stop Action verifier, executed by our llama.cpp VLN driver on a Jetson Orin NX 16,GB. Across 1,839 closed-loop R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes, all four-bit formats achieve nearly identical success rates, yet their on-board step energy spans 36.8 × 36.8\times by execution path. Only IQ4_NL under our driver fits, with 11.35,GB resident memory, 20.8 × 20.8\times higher speed, and 13.3 × 13.3\times lower step energy than storage-streamed BF16. Thus, runtime—not bit width—determines whether the model fits. LATTE reuses hidden activations from the frozen backbone without an extra forward pass, raising the deployed four-bit model to 58.02% SR, above BF16, while adding under 2% of the step’s latency and energy.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了EdgeVLN(EdgeVLN ) , 即一个可部署的量化视觉-语言导航模型,结合了StrewVLN和LATTE(LATTE ) , 由我们的Lama.cpp VLN 司机在Jetson Orin NX 16,GB上执行。 在整个1,839个闭路R2R VLN-CE val-unseen事件上,所有的四位格式都取得了几乎相同的成功率,然而他们的机上步态能量跨度为36.8×36.8\乘执行路径。 我们司机下方只有IQ4_NL适配,拥有11.35,GB常住内存,20.8×20.8\时速度较高,13.3×13.3\时步能量低于储流BF16. 因此,运行时间——而不是位宽——决定模型是否合适。 LATTE重新使用冷冻骨干中隐藏的激活,没有额外的前行通道,将部署的四位元模型提升到58.02%的SR,高于BF16,同时增加了不到2%的阶梯的延缓和能量.

blocks.en: Rithvik Jonna is a Ph.D. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Johns Hopkins University, Whiting School of Engineering. His research interests include embedded AI systems, energy-efficient machine learning, robotics, with a focus on deploying multimodal perception systems on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Contact him at djonna1@jh.edu.
blocks.zh: Rithvik Jonna是约翰·霍普金斯大学,惠廷工程学院电气与计算机工程专业的博士生. 他的研究兴趣包括嵌入式AI系统,节能机器学习,机器人,重点是在受资源限制的机器人平台上部署多式联运感知系统. 联系他 djonna1@jh.edu.

Namgung received B.S. degrees in computer science and in military arts and science from the Republic of Korea Naval Academy, Changwon, South Korea. Contact him at mnamgun1@jh.edu.
